name: backoff attempt 1 without Retry-After
spec_quote: attempt 1 → 1.5

name: backoff digit Retry-After with surrounding spaces
spec_quote: When retry_after is a string of digits only (surrounding spaces allowed) whose value is ≤ cap → that value as a float.

name: backoff above-cap Retry-After falls back to capped exponential
spec_quote: A Retry-After that is a date, empty, negative-looking ("-5") or above cap ("120") is ignored → the exponential value. ... 6 → 30.0 (capped).

name: backoff negative-looking Retry-After falls back to exponential
spec_quote: A Retry-After that is a date, empty, negative-looking ("-5") or above cap ("120") is ignored → the exponential value.

name: is_blocked 429 always blocked
spec_quote: 429 → true, whatever the body.

name: is_blocked 403 ordinary JSON is not a wall
spec_quote: A 403 whose body is ordinary JSON such as {"message": "Not authorized for PCSX"} → false (a real answer, not a wall).

name: is_blocked 500 empty body is not blocked
spec_quote: 500 with an empty body → false.

name: is_blocked 503 with challenge title
spec_quote: Any status → true when a <title> in the first 5,000 characters starts with "just a moment", "attention required", "access denied" or "security check" (case-insensitive).

name: is_blocked 200 normal page is not blocked
spec_quote: 200 with a normal page → false.

name: parse_icims reads Job Locations label
spec_quote: The location field label may read "Location", "Locations", "Job Location" or "Job Locations" ... url = the href up to /job (query string dropped).

name: parse_icims same job id twice is one posting
spec_quote: The same job id twice on one page → one posting.

name: parse_sitemal splits comma parenthesis into location
spec_quote: When the title ends with a parenthesis that contains a comma — "Data Analyst (Houston, TX, US, 77042)" — the part before it is the title and the inside is the location ("Houston, TX, US, 77042").

name: parse_sitemal keeps Remote parenthesis in title
spec_quote: A trailing parenthesis without a comma ("Engineer (Remote)") stays in the title and location is "".

name: parse_sitemal decodes entities in title
spec_quote: CDATA removed, entities decoded.

name: parse_oracle RequisitionNumber fallback and skip entries without id (title field not specified, so title expectation assumes Title field)
spec_quote: The posting id is Id, else RequisitionNumber; an entry with neither is skipped. | spec note: parse_oracle title field is not defined in the spec.

name: parse_jazz reads list markup location
spec_quote: location = the text after the next `fa-map-marker'>` within 600 characters, else "".

name: parse_jazz table markup drops query
spec_quote: Table markup: `Title` → url = `https:///apply/jobs/details/` (query dropped), location = the text of the next `` after the cell that holds the link (within 800 characters), else "".

name: jobvite_range parses 1-50 of 63
spec_quote: From `class="jv-pagination-text">1-50 of 63` (spaces around "-" allowed, case-insensitive "of") → [1, 50, 63].

name: jobvite_range returns null without pagination text
spec_quote: None → null.

name: parse_rss removes duplicate city/name
spec_quote: location = the <tt:city> and <tt:name> values inside that item, in order, duplicates removed, joined with ", " ... CDATA wrappers removed from the title.

name: parse_rss joins city and name with comma
spec_quote: location = the <tt:city> and <tt:name> values inside that item, in order, duplicates removed, joined with ", ".

name: parse_avature builds location from slug before United-States
spec_quote: Location from the slug: the words before "United-States" with "-" → " ", then ", United States" ("Darlington-South-Carolina-United-States-Data-Analyst" → "Darlington South Carolina, United States").

name: parse_avature slug starting with United-States
spec_quote: a slug that starts with "United-States" → "United States".

name: ukg_load_url relative valid URL
spec_quote: Returns `https://<host>/<tenant as in the URL>/JobBoard/<id>` only when the URL is on the same host, the tenant matches (case-insensitive), the second segment is JobBoard (any case), the id has 36 characters of hex digits and dashes, and the path ends exactly in JobBoardView/LoadSearchResults.

name: ukg_load_url absolute same-host URL uses tenant as in URL
spec_quote: Reads `loadUrl: "/<TENANT>/JobBoard/<36-char id>/JobBoardView/LoadSearchResults"` (relative or absolute). Returns `https://<host>/<tenant as in the URL>/JobBoard/<id>` ...

name: ukg_load_url rejects short board id
spec_quote: ... the id has 36 characters of hex digits and dashes ... otherwise null.

name: clean_ident jobvite accepts careers/acme lower-cased
spec_quote: jobvite: `acme` or `careers/acme` are both kept (lower-cased); the tenant part must not be vendor infrastructure, "search" or "viewall".

name: clean_ident ultipro accepts recruiting3.ultipro.ca
spec_quote: ultipro: host may also be `recruiting<digits>.ultipro.com` (e.g. recruiting3) or end in `.ultipro.ca`. ... Returned as `<host>/<TENANT upper-case>/JobBoard/<board id lower-case>`.
